title: Support a bar before withdrawing its carriage
context: A support must not be removed from beneath a precision part until another support carries the load. This task checks the order and continuous control during a two arm transfer. The optical bar is represented by a printed training part.
scoring: Score zero if the bar lower face ever falls below z 754.5 mm or tilt exceeds 10 degrees. Before the carriage has retracted more than 105 mm the lower face must stay at or above z 814.5 mm. A downward change greater than 12 mm between adjacent 20 Hz observations also makes the episode score zero. Carriage retraction beyond 40 mm earns 0.25. Retraction beyond 105 mm while meeting the bar safety checks earns 0.5. After that the bar centre must be within 4 mm on every axis of x 160 mm and y 190 mm and z 787.5 mm. Yaw must be below 5 degrees. Translation must be below 8 mm per second and rotation below 0.1 radians per second. This earns 0.75. Both measured grippers open beyond 35 mm raises this to 1.0. Full success must hold for 2 seconds. All other outcomes score zero.
fidelity: The optical bar is a rigid printed training surrogate with a raised handling tab. No glass fracture or optical performance is simulated. The carriage is a passive prismatic joint with physical support contacts. The white cradle has a floor and two retaining rails. Rigid contact and numerical drop limits approximate damage avoidance. No person or powered machinery is present.
instruction: Hold the blue optical bar level with the left arm before pulling its grey support carriage out with the right arm. Keep the bar supported while the carriage clears it. Lower the bar into the white storage cradle. Release both grippers. All equipment is unpowered and no person is present.
setup: Use the bimanual YAM station with the tabletop at z 747.5 mm. x points forward. y points left. z points up. Every part is printed PA12 polymer. scene_inventory.json lists every object and every solid with exact dimensions and initial positions in metres and masses in kilograms. Object positions use the world frame. Solid positions use their body frame. Joint anchors and limits are listed with the articulated object. The setup image shows this fixed layout. All joint positions start at zero.
run_limit: 600 control steps at 20 Hz. This is 30 seconds of control time.
reset_notes: Restore every object to the starting pose in scene_inventory.json and every joint to zero. Nothing is consumed. Use one epoch with seed 0 and object_jitter=0.
scores: Both uploaded videos show the same scripted demo with score 1.0. No model score is claimed.
